title: Regions
source: CMap's `region` key names the file (CMap::LoadKey, 0x893B0). A region holds a vector of province ids (CRegion +0x8..+0xC) and its name; CMap::AssignRegions (0x48FAC0) gives each province its regions; a word that is not a number inside a region's block - `peace` in the base game - is the region's useForPeace (CRegion +0x6C) (FINDINGS-airorders.md section 4). Every region name is also a trigger scope (LoadKeyRegionScopeArm). The file's own grammar, beyond that, was not read.

patterns.desc: a region; its name is a trigger scope and a name of kind region

region.desc: province ids; a word that is not a number (`peace`) marks the region for peace offers
